name: TC-AN-QB-014 — 清空按钮：无参与人时点击清空 [P2]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开，已选参与人区域为空（前置条件：选择无参与人的节点，不清空存量数据）
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { /* 寻找无参与人的节点 */ const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) { const text = rows[i].innerText; const cells = text.split('\t'); const hasNoParticipant = cells.some(c => c.trim() === '-' || c.trim() === '—'); if (hasNoParticipant) { const editBtn = Array.from(rows[i].querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '编辑'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, rowIndex: i }; } } } const editBtn = rows[0]?.querySelector('button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, rowIndex: 0 }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 选择无参与人的节点编辑

steps.expression: (() => { const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); const count = container ? container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length : -1; return { participantCount: count }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const clearBtn = btns.find(b => b.textContent.trim() === '清空'); if (!clearBtn) return { hasClearBtn: false }; clearBtn.click(); return { hasClearBtn: true, clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const popconfirm = document.querySelector('.ant-popconfirm'); const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); const container = document.querySelector('[class*=selectedLabel]'); const stillEmpty = container ? container.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-selection-item').length === 0 : false; return { hasPopconfirm: !!popconfirm, popText: popconfirm ? popconfirm.textContent.trim().slice(0, 100) : null, toastTexts, stillEmpty }; })()
steps.description: 验证无参与人时清空的行为

_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 选择一个无参与人的审核节点\n2. 进入编辑页\n3. 点击「清空」按钮
_testDesign.expectedResult: 1. 不报错、不崩溃\n2. 可能弹出确认气泡或直接提示无数据\n3. 页面状态保持不变
